<a name="support-policy"></a>
## Support Policy

For all Laravel releases, bug fixes are provided for 18 months and security fixes are provided for 2 years.

| Version | PHP (*)   | Release             | Bug Fixes Until     | Security Fixes Until |
| ------- |-----------| ------------------- | ------------------- | -------------------- |
| 10      | 8.1 - 8.3 | February 14th, 2023 | August 6th, 2024    | February 4th, 2025   |
| 11      | 8.2 - 8.4 | March 12th, 2024    | September 3rd, 2025 | March 12th, 2026     |
| 12      | 8.2 - 8.5 | February 24th, 2025 | August 13th, 2026   | February 24th, 2027  |

(*) Supported PHP versions

## Laravel 13

| 13      | 8.3 - 8.5 | a row outside the Support Policy section does not count |
